name: General Administration of Customs of China (GACC)
aliases: General Administration of Customs of China
description: China's customs agency; co-issues mineral export-control announcements with MOFCOM and enforces licences at the border (no licence, no release). Chinese name: 海关总署.

name: China Unreliable Entity List Working Mechanism
description: Inter-ministerial mechanism, with its office in MOFCOM, that investigates foreign entities and decides Unreliable Entity List listings and measures. Chinese name: 不可靠实体清单工作机制.

name: Jiangsu Semiconductor Industry Association
description: Provincial chip industry association that petitioned MOFCOM for the 2025 anti-dumping case on US analog chips. Chinese name: 江苏省半导体行业协会.

name: MOFCOM Trade Remedy and Investigation Bureau
description: MOFCOM bureau that runs China's anti-dumping, anti-discrimination and trade-barrier investigations. Chinese name: 商务部贸易救济调查局、贸易救济局.
